Calling provider — Select Webex or Dubber before enabling users.
Webex storage — 1 year, 100 GB per organization, compliance officers.
Dubber Go — 30 days in the Dubber portal.
E2EE — Recording disables Calling end-to-end encryption.
WxCC QM — AI QM add-ons are taught in T3-R09. Confirm the SKU on the live order guide.
